_comment: Copy this file to appsettings.json (or appsettings.Production.json) ON THE SERVER and fill in the real values. appsettings*.json is gitignored on purpose so secrets never land in the repo. Both Google login and password-reset email depend on the sections below being populated.

Google._comment: ClientId MUST match the frontend assets/config/app-config.json googleClientId, and the production domain must be an Authorized JavaScript origin in Google Cloud Console.

Email._comment: Required for password-reset codes and notification emails. If Host is empty, all emails are skipped and forgot-password will report a send failure.
